title: Receipts Clearing House — Shortcut → Apps Script POST body
description: JSON the iOS Shortcut sends to the Apps Script /exec endpoint via Get Contents of URL (POST, Request Body = JSON). The Apps Script doPost() reads e.postData.contents and parses this.

token.description: Shared secret. Must equal the SHARED_TOKEN script property or the write is rejected (401-style {ok:false,error:'unauthorized'}).

vendor.description: Reviewed vendor name. Empty/absent -> Apps Script stores 'Unknown'.

total.description: Reviewed total amount, e.g. 47.32. Sent as a number; string also accepted and coerced.

entity.description: Required, user-selected. 'SPLIT' makes Apps Script set Needs Split = TRUE.

note.description: Optional free text. Defaults to empty.

date.description: Receipt date (as OCR'd or edited). Defaults to today (yyyy-MM-dd) if absent.

category.description: User-selected. Defaults to 'Uncategorized'. Use 'Mixed' for SPLIT receipts.

confDate.description: Heuristic OCR confidence 0-100 for the date field. Stored read-only for audit.

confVendor.description: Heuristic OCR confidence 0-100 for the vendor field.

confTotal.description: Heuristic OCR confidence 0-100 for the total field.

imageBase64.description: The captured receipt photo, Base64-encoded (Shortcuts 'Base64 Encode' action). Apps Script decodes -> Drive.

imageMime.description: MIME type of the encoded image. 'image/jpeg' for Take Photo / Scan Document JPEG output.
